title: Source-backed Wazuh ATT&CK technique cohorts after independently authorized local Case traversal
goal: Expose bounded, deterministic MITRE ATT&CK technique attribution present on real-shaped offline Wazuh 4.x alerts.json, but only after existing loopback Case/Timeline/typed-source owner authorization; no inference, new ACL, storage, query engine or mutation. Complete the existing read-only analyst loopback Wazuh cohort screen so the source-backed labels are actually inspectable by an analyst, not hidden inside JSON.
invariants: Existing offline operator-controlled source bytes only, canonical Wazuh 4.x rule.mitre.id technique labels, no model-inferred technique
The source of truth for read permission remains the existing synthetic in-memory Case and typed-source owner; label is never an ACL, proof of exploitation, or verified Finding/Evidence
All technique values are counted only inside already-authorized collectDemoCaseTriageWithObserver callback, after Case/Timeline/typed-source access; do not count hidden or denied events
Preserve existing JSON receipt format and fields; add at most 10 source technique cohorts with separate unmapped and distinct counts
An alert may have several source technique IDs; duplicates within an alert must not multiply that alert, across tags counts may overlap
Never output alert IDs, hostnames, full_log, source raw previews, tokens, or invented technique names
Do not modify #186 frozen L2 source, #185, PR #36 baseline, main or canonical docs
Browser displays technique cohorts as source-claimed metadata only via textContent; no HTML interpolation, no unsupported technique-specific drilldown endpoint
Do not change #187 and #216 reviewed source SHA; exact Git blobs for the five production/test UI/Go paths are re-used without semantic changes
security_properties: No new third-party dependency, provider, listener, permission namespace, source adapter, mutation or production claim
Fail closed and output zero bytes on malformed/oversized technique labels, denied principal or incomplete typed-source traversal
Technique ID restricted to Tdddd or Tdddd.ddd ASCII; at most 16 labels per Wazuh alert; no path/URL/html/script labels
Bounded by existing 8 MiB local file and <=5000 import events; no raw source data in receipt

migration.rationale: Additive field to bounded read-only offline triage JSON output

rollback.strategy: Revert source technique aggregation and new tests; original offline Wazuh triage JSON remains unmodified
verification: No mutation of operator source files
Original Wazuh agent/rule/time window and Level aggregations still function

Shared existing authenticated local /demo-wazuh-cohorts route serializes same additive receipt; no new route or browser UI claimed
Structured tests with on-disk Wazuh samples, two-Case owner snapshot, denied principal, metadata injection rejection, tag multiplicity, top-ten deterministic ties

Full original Timeline Go and Node tests run on exact candidate commit; mandatory changed-security-critical coverage floor unchanged
Existing Node 24 analyst browser exercises authorized technique metadata display, malicious labels fail-closed, legacy receipt compatible and stale/denied response emits no partial source content
Full Timeline Go/Node and Command–Investigate host pipelines plus mandatory engineering kernel run on consolidated SHA
